capabilities: copy block reference link for selection or current line
reuse existing block IDs or generate unique ones
strip markdown prefixes from alias text
switch between alias, raw, and embed link formats
problem: Generating block reference links requires manually adding block IDs and assembling the wikilink; this automates copying a ready-to-paste link to the clipboard.
summary: Command-based tool that copies clickable block reference links for the selected text or current line, with configurable aliases and link formats.
